name: Correlated Drop-off and Scene Diagnosis
query: Which episode in Bhaichara had the highest audience drop-off rate, and what was happening in the script during that scene?
description: Requires querying SQL for drop-off telemetry, locating the 38.4% peak in Ep 103 at 00:13:10, and searching transcripts for scene dialogue.

name: Quantitative Regional Telemetry
query: What is the viewer share and average rating of Bhaichara in Haryana compared to Delhi-NCR?
description: Requires structured aggregation from regional_performance table without querying transcripts.

name: Qualitative Narrative Search
query: What dialogue occurred at Murthal Toll Plaza between Jaideep and Virender?
description: Requires transcript search over scene locations and character lines without executing SQL.

name: Partial Data - Present in DB, Missing in Transcripts
query: Why did viewers drop off at 18:45 in Episode 1 of Dopamine Hustle?
description: Telemetry reports 41.2% dropoff, but transcripts have no dialogue. Agent must flag the missing transcript record without hallucinating dialogue.

name: Partial Data - Present in Script, Missing in DB
query: What happened on the High Court steps in Episode 8 of Bhaichara and what were its viewership numbers?
description: Script contains scene, but SQL DB has 0 rows for Episode 108. Agent must report dialogue and state that telemetry is absent/unreleased.

name: Out of Scope / Non-Existent Entity
query: What was the viewer completion rate for Season 4 of Game of Thrones?
description: Neither database contains Game of Thrones. Agent must report absence without hallucinating fake ratings.
